Fix Netlio for anime — episode number mapping + wildcard CDN matching

Two issues prevented Netlio from showing anime streams:

1. Episode number mapping:
   The Netlio API uses absolute episode numbers (e.g., S12 starts at ep
   244, not 1). Stremio requests S12E1 but the API has episode 244.

   uses dozens of rotating CDN domains — new ones weren't matched.
   Fix: match by URL path pattern instead (cf-master, /v4/, /hls3/)
   which covers all Netlio CDN URLs regardless of domain.

   side JS decryption. These are now skipped.
